sourceEvidence.section: lead guiding verb versus metal noun
sourceEvidence.hashScope: original factual summary text, not source page bytes

issues.message: 遗漏常用的动词“领先”“通向”“过某种生活”，以及名词“带头、榜样”“牵引绳”“导线”“铅笔芯”。须分义补齐，每个核心义至少两例。
“领先优势”和“调查线索”被合并，各只有一个例句，搭配和近义词也混在一起。须拆开，各补足两例。
“主角、主演”和修饰名词的“主要的”属于常用功能，现各仅一例。应提升为完整核心义；partOfSpeech 同时补入 adjective。
因果用法遗漏 lead someone to do。现有 lead to doing 说明本身正确，但须明确区分介词 to 与宾语后的不定式，避免总结被理解为所有“使得”用法都只能接 -ing。
不能笼统把所有动词 lead 都归为 /liːd/：加铅、包铅义动词读 /led/，过去式和过去分词固定为 leaded。相关发音、变形及“可写 leaded”的说明须一致修正。
metal 是上位词，Pb 是元素符号，不应列作可替换的近义表达；non-metal 也不是铅这一具体元素的反向表达。应保留分类说明，清空不合适的条目。
lead pipe 通常指管体用铅制成的管道，不能泛指任何含铅的管道。
mislead 应说明为前缀派生词；原例句译文额外断定出口在别处，超出英文信息。宜改用明确的 mislead someone into doing，并准确翻译。
Cambridge 内容未取得，不能继续用该 sourceId 支撑正文。应移除其支撑关系；已取得的维基词典内容按实际范围引用，其他可靠语言知识可使用空 sourceIds。
led to saving both time and money 语法成立，但该句表达较生硬；宜换成结果关系更具体、自然的原创例句。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对全部列出的词典义及常用扩展。补丁补齐常用动词、名词和形容词功能，拆开领先与线索，使每个核心义至少有两例；专业义按层次处理。排版铅条义按实际读音 /led/ 处理。机械、航海、药物研发及部分历史用法列入清单但不展开。词源叙述与已取得材料相符，现有阶段只描述引导义的发展，没有把两条独立来源串成一链。

新增完整核心义，区别于人带路及因果 lead to。

senseInventory.assessment: 新增 take the lead、follow someone's lead 的行动语境。
移出调查线索，补齐第二个比赛例句。
独立成义，配两例及跟进线索的搭配。
提升为核心义，分别示范角色和扮演者。
提升为核心义，补齐两个定语用法例句及词性标注。
补齐英式日常常用义，说明美式通常用 leash。
补齐电气连接语境；不把 battery lead 误教成电池接线柱本身。
两例保留，修正铅管解释及不合适的近义、反向条目。
新增完整核心义，说明现代铅笔芯主要用石墨制成，并示范材料义与可数替芯。

senseInventory.assessment: 补入专业义以覆盖“铅条”；按实际术语读 /led/，不沿用源文名词分组造成的读音混淆。
专业用法，不作为初中核心义展开。

senseInventory.sense: 营销中的潜在客户或客户线索（n. /liːd/）
senseInventory.assessment: 以一个职场例句补入拓展义，区别于已经成交的客户。
机械专业义，不展开。
机械专业义，不展开。

senseInventory.sense: 药物研发中的先导化合物（n. /liːd/）
senseInventory.assessment: 药学专业义，不展开。

senseInventory.sense: 屋面铅皮及铺铅的屋顶（n. /led/，屋顶义常见复数 leads）
senseInventory.assessment: 建筑及历史用法，不作为核心义展开；包铅动词例句仅提供相关语境。
借材料指弹药的用法，不作为初中核心义展开。

senseInventory.sense: 航海测深铅锤及相关测深用法（/led/）

{"id":"lead-v-route","title":"通向；通往","meaning":"道路、楼梯、门等连接或通向某个地方。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，主语通常是道路或通道。to 后接地点时表示通向，不是在说明某事导致结果。","examples":[{"id":"lead-route-eg-1","senseId":"lead-v-route","en":"This path leads to the beach.","zh":"这条小路通向海滩。","note":"主语是 path，没有被带领的人作宾语。"},{"id":"lead-route-eg-2","senseId":"lead-v-route","en":"The stairs lead up to the roof.","zh":"这段楼梯向上通到屋顶。","note":"up 补充向上的方向。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a road/path leads to a place","zh":"道路／小路通向某地","note":"to 后接地点。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"lead into the garden","zh":"通入花园","note":"into 突出通到内部。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"lead out of the building","zh":"通向楼外","note":"out of 突出从内部通往外部。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"go to","zh":"通到","note":"道路作主语时也可这样表达，如 This road goes to the station；go 还有许多其他含义。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"两者可用于道路通向某处；不能据此把所有 go 都换成 lead。","contrastingNote":"空间连接没有统一反义词；通向不同地点也不构成反义关系。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"lead-v-life","title":"过某种生活","meaning":"以某种方式生活。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，常用 lead a/an + 形容词 + life；过去式为 led。","examples":[{"id":"lead-life-eg-1","senseId":"lead-v-life","en":"My grandparents lead a quiet life in the countryside.","zh":"我的祖父母在乡下过着平静的生活。","note":"lead a quiet life 表示过着平静的生活。"},{"id":"lead-life-eg-2","senseId":"lead-v-life","en":"She leads a busy life, working during the day and studying at night.","zh":"她白天工作，晚上学习，生活十分忙碌。","note":"lead 在这里不是带领别人，而是描述自己的生活方式。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"lead a/an + adjective + life","zh":"过着某种生活","note":"life 前通常用形容词说明生活方式。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"lead a normal life","zh":"过正常的生活","note":"描述生活状态。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"lead an active life","zh":"过积极活跃的生活","note":"描述经常参与活动的生活方式。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"live a ... life","zh":"过……的生活","note":"在此结构中与 lead a ... life 意思接近；live 还可直接表示居住，如 live in a town。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"本义可与 live a ... life 对换，但不能据此把 live in London 改成 lead in London。","contrastingNote":"生活方式由形容词区分，lead 本身在这个结构中没有通用反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"lead-n-initiative","title":"带头；供人效仿的做法","meaning":"行动中的主动引领，或别人可以跟着做的示范。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/。take the lead 表示主动牵头，follow someone's lead 表示照着某人的做法行动；本义不要求存在比分或名次。","examples":[{"id":"lead-initiative-eg-1","senseId":"lead-n-initiative","en":"Sam took the lead in organising the class picnic.","zh":"萨姆牵头组织了班级野餐。","note":"这里的 take the lead 指主动组织，不是比赛领先。"},{"id":"lead-initiative-eg-2","senseId":"lead-n-initiative","en":"Everyone followed her lead and brought a reusable cup.","zh":"大家都照着她的做法，带来了可重复使用的杯子。","note":"follow her lead 表示效仿她的做法。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"take the lead in doing something","zh":"带头做某事","note":"in 后用 -ing 形式。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"take the lead","zh":"牵头；带头","note":"在组织行动的语境中使用。","kind":"fixed-expression"},{"en":"follow someone's lead","zh":"效仿某人的做法","note":"不一定指实际跟着某人走。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"take the initiative","zh":"主动采取行动","note":"强调先行动；take the lead 还可能包含带动其他人。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"follow someone's lead","zh":"跟着某人的做法行动","note":"在谁先带头、谁跟着做的关系中，与 take the lead 对照。"}],"similarNote":"主动行动和带领他人常有联系，但不是每次主动行动都带动了别人。","contrastingNote":"这是行动角色的对照，跟随本身不表示消极或做错。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-lead-etymology"]}

{"id":"lead-n-role","title":"主角；主演","meaning":"戏剧、电影等中的主要角色，也可指扮演主要角色的人。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，是可数名词。play the lead 中指角色；the two leads 可指两位主演。","examples":[{"id":"lead-eg-9","senseId":"lead-n-role","en":"Nina played the lead in the school show.","zh":"妮娜在学校演出中担任主角。","note":"play the lead 表示扮演主角。"},{"id":"lead-role-eg-2","senseId":"lead-n-role","en":"The two leads stayed after rehearsal to practise the final scene.","zh":"两位主演在排练结束后留下来练习最后一场戏。","note":"复数 leads 在这里指扮演主要角色的演员。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"play the lead in a play/film","zh":"在戏剧／电影中担任主角","note":"这里的 lead 是名词。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"the female lead","zh":"女主角；女主演","note":"可指角色，也可指演员，须结合上下文判断。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"leading role","zh":"主要角色；主角","note":"与角色义接近，不能直接用来指演员本人。"},{"en":"protagonist","zh":"故事的主人公","note":"侧重叙事中心人物，不指扮演此人的演员。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"supporting role","zh":"配角","note":"与主要角色在戏份或叙事地位上对照。"},{"en":"supporting actor","zh":"配角演员","note":"与主演这一演员身份对照。"}],"similarNote":"分清故事中的角色和扮演角色的人。","contrastingNote":"角色与角色比较，演员与演员比较。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-lead-etymology"]}

{"id":"lead-adj-main","title":"主要的；领衔的","meaning":"在某项工作或活动中担任主要角色的。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，通常放在名词前，如 lead singer、lead researcher。lead singer 中 lead 修饰 singer；play the lead 中 lead 则是名词。","examples":[{"id":"lead-eg-10","senseId":"lead-adj-main","en":"He is the lead singer in the band.","zh":"他是乐队的主唱。","note":"lead 修饰 singer，表示担任主唱的歌手。"},{"id":"lead-main-eg-2","senseId":"lead-adj-main","en":"Dr Chen is the lead researcher on the project.","zh":"陈博士是这个项目的首席研究员。","note":"lead researcher 指领衔研究工作的人。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"lead + noun","zh":"主要的／领衔的……","note":"通常作名词前的定语。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"lead singer","zh":"主唱","note":"指乐队中担任主要演唱任务的人。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"lead actor","zh":"主演","note":"lead 修饰 actor，表示担任主要角色的演员。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"main","zh":"主要的","note":"含义更广；固定职务或角色名称不一定能机械替换。"},{"en":"principal","zh":"首要的；主要的","note":"较正式，也用于某些主要职务或角色。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"supporting","zh":"配角的","note":"在 lead actor 与 supporting actor 这类表演角色中形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"意思接近不表示每个固定搭配都可以替换。","contrastingNote":"supporting 的这一对照限于表演角色等相关语境。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"lead-n-leash","title":"动物牵引绳","meaning":"拴在狗等动物身上、供人牵引的绳或带。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，是可数名词，主要用于英式英语；美式英语通常用 leash。","examples":[{"id":"lead-leash-eg-1","senseId":"lead-n-leash","en":"Please keep your dog on a lead near the playground.","zh":"在游乐场附近，请给你的狗拴好牵引绳。","note":"on a lead 表示拴着牵引绳。"},{"id":"lead-leash-eg-2","senseId":"lead-n-leash","en":"I hung the dog's lead beside the front door.","zh":"我把狗的牵引绳挂在了前门旁。","note":"这里的 lead 是一件可数的物品。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"keep a dog on a lead","zh":"让狗拴着牵引绳","note":"常见于遛狗或公共场所的提醒。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a dog lead","zh":"狗的牵引绳","note":"英式日常表达。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"leash","zh":"牵引绳","note":"在此义中意思相同，是美式英语通常使用的词。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"在牵引狗的语境中，lead 和 leash 主要体现地区用词差异。","contrastingNote":"牵引绳是物品名，没有通用反义词；on a lead 与 off the lead 对照的是是否拴绳。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-lead-etymology"]}

{"id":"lead-n-wire","title":"导线；连接线","meaning":"连接电源、设备或电路部件的电线或电缆。","usageNote":"读 /liːd/，是可数名词。日常设备电源线的这一叫法常见于英式英语，电气专业语境也使用 lead。","examples":[{"id":"lead-wire-eg-1","senseId":"lead-n-wire","en":"Unplug the power lead before moving the printer.","zh":"移动打印机前，先拔掉电源线。","note":"power lead 指连接电源的线。"},{"id":"lead-wire-eg-2","senseId":"lead-n-wire","en":"The red lead connects the battery to the lamp.","zh":"红色导线把电池和灯连接起来。","note":"这里指连接用的导线，不是金属铅。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a lead connects A to B","zh":"一根导线连接 A 和 B","note":"connect A to B 表示把两者连接起来。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"power lead","zh":"电源线","note":"美式日常英语常说 power cord。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"battery lead","zh":"电池连接线","note":"指连接电池的导线或电缆。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"wire","zh":"电线；导线","note":"范围更广；lead 突出用于连接设备或电路部件的功能。"},{"en":"power cord","zh":"电源线","note":"与 power lead 对应，不能替代所有电路中的 lead。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"根据连接功能和具体设备选择 wire、lead 或 power cord。","contrastingNote":"导线是具体物品，没有通用反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-lead-etymology"]}

{"id":"lead-n-pencil","title":"铅笔芯；替芯","meaning":"铅笔中用于书写的芯，也指自动铅笔使用的一根根替芯。","usageNote":"读 /led/。现代铅笔芯主要用石墨制成，并非金属铅。指芯的材料时可不可数，指单根替芯时可数。","examples":[{"id":"lead-pencil-eg-1","senseId":"lead-n-pencil","en":"The lead in my pencil broke during the test.","zh":"考试时，我的铅笔芯断了。","note":"这里指铅笔里面的芯。"},{"id":"lead-pencil-eg-2","senseId":"lead-n-pencil","en":"I bought a pack of leads for my mechanical pencil.","zh":"我给自动铅笔买了一盒替芯。","note":"leads 指多根替芯，读 /ledz/。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"the lead in a pencil","zh":"铅笔里的芯","note":"不要把这个名称理解为铅笔芯含有金属铅。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"collocations":[{"en":"pencil lead","zh":"铅笔芯","note":"读 /led/。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"spare leads","zh":"备用铅笔芯","note":"通常指自动铅笔的替芯。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"graphite 是石墨这一材料名，不与包含其他成分的铅笔芯完全等同。","contrastingNote":"铅笔芯是具体物品或材料，没有通用反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-lead-etymology"]}
